sql: with agg as (select segment as scope, week, market, band, product, cast(sum(contracts) as double) as contracts, cast(sum(offers) as double) as offers from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 6 group by all), win as (select scope, week, market, band, product, sum(contracts) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as contracts, sum(offers) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as offers from agg) select scope, week, market, band, product, case when week < 3 then null else case when offers < 8 then null else (contracts) / nullif(offers, 0) end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else offers end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week

with agg as (select segment as scope, week, market, band, product, cast(sum(awaiting_offer) as double) as awaiting_offer, cast(sum(first_offers) as double) as first_offers from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 6 group by all), win as (select scope, week, market, band, product, sum(awaiting_offer) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as awaiting_offer, sum(first_offers) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as first_offers from agg) select scope, week, market, band, product, case when week < 3 then null else case when awaiting_offer < 8 then null else (first_offers) / nullif(awaiting_offer, 0) end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else awaiting_offer end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week

with agg as (select segment as scope, week, market, band, product, cast(sum(reno_actual_sum) as double) as reno_actual_sum, cast(sum(reno_estimate_sum) as double) as reno_estimate_sum, cast(sum(renos_completed) as double) as renos_completed from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 6 group by all), win as (select scope, week, market, band, product, sum(reno_actual_sum) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as reno_actual_sum, sum(reno_estimate_sum) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as reno_estimate_sum, sum(renos_completed) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as renos_completed from agg) select scope, week, market, band, product, case when week < 3 then null else case when renos_completed < 4 then null else (reno_actual_sum) / nullif(reno_estimate_sum, 0) - 1 end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else renos_completed end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week

with agg as (select segment as scope, week, market, band, product, cast(sum(offers) as double) as offers, cast(sum(spread_sum) as double) as spread_sum from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 6 group by all), win as (select scope, week, market, band, product, sum(offers) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as offers, sum(spread_sum) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as spread_sum from agg) select scope, week, market, band, product, case when week < 3 then null else case when offers < 8 then null else (spread_sum) / nullif(offers, 0) end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else offers end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week

with agg as (select segment as scope, week, market, band, product, cast(sum(dtfo_sum) as double) as dtfo_sum, cast(sum(first_offers) as double) as first_offers, cast(sum(showings_sum) as double) as showings_sum from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 6 group by all), win as (select scope, week, market, band, product, sum(dtfo_sum) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as dtfo_sum, sum(first_offers) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as first_offers, sum(showings_sum) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as showings_sum from agg) select scope, week, market, band, product, case when week < 3 then null else case when first_offers < 8 then null else (showings_sum) / nullif(dtfo_sum, 0) * 7 end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else first_offers end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week

with agg as (select 'portfolio' as scope, week, cast(sum(contracts) as double) as contracts, cast(sum(offers) as double) as offers from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 6 group by all), win as (select scope, week, sum(contracts) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as contracts, sum(offers) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as offers from agg) select scope, week, case when week < 3 then null else case when offers < 30 then null else (contracts) / nullif(offers, 0) end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else offers end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week
